name: CRONUS — unique shape-first chassis
notes:
Official cronus_cns3m, bespoke primary hull and weapon-bearing geometry (forward_hull); unique head (beak), jointed two-stage arms, multi-stage legs, physically recessed counted muzzles. Miniature silhouette likeness still draft pending angle-by-angle refinement.
Forensic sculpt pass: eliminate isolated voxel shards at identified measured 6-face components, and replace the Werewolf's oversized sensor with a narrow recessed front mount solidly integrated with its compact head.
